title: k8s-ai-observability values
description: A typo in releaseLabel or grafana.dashboardLabel is otherwise undetectable until someone notices an empty board, which is why this schema exists at all. It catches the shape and the type; it cannot catch a well-formed value that names the wrong release — helm test does that, on a live cluster.

releaseLabel.description: The `release:` selector on the PrometheusRules and ServiceMonitors. WRONG VALUE = NO ERROR: the rules never evaluate and the boards stay empty.

dashboardLabel.description: The sidecar's discovery key. WRONG VALUE = NO ERROR: the ConfigMaps exist and are never imported.

dashboardLabelValue.description: A STRING. `1` unquoted is a number in YAML and a label value must be a string; quoting it here is not stylistic.

tag.description: Empty means Chart.appVersion, which is the coupling that keeps the chart and the published image in step. Pinning it by hand is how it goes stale — a green install running an old simulator.

scrapeInterval.description: MUST stay <= 30s. verify.sh asserts rate(...[1m]) > 0, and rate() needs two samples in the window: at 60s it gets one and returns nothing, which reads as a dead counter.

profile.description: ⚠️ These numbers interlock with the 2s LLMHighTTFT threshold, verify.sh's L3b bound and every promtool expectation. Change one and re-derive the others; the chart refuses to render if the tenants stop straddling capacity.

kvBlockTokens.description: vLLM's KV block size; hits are quantised to whole blocks upstream, so they are here too. 16 is vLLM's default.

fakeGpuExporter.description: Set false if the fake-gpu-operator chart already ships its own ServiceMonitor — two of them means conflicting scrape configs for one target.

modelName.description: ⚠️ An IDENTITY, not a label. The recording rules aggregate by (model_name); the two tenants MUST be distinct or they merge into one series describing neither.

prefixCacheHitRate.description: A RATE in 0.0-1.0, not a percentage. Out of range, the simulator rejects the whole profile and silently keeps the previous one.
